scientific_integrity: An analytic local-transport proof gives the infinite-parameter claim. The separate conservative finite-volume implementation supplies corroborating—not exhaustive—checks. Earlier model equations and general three-state RTP results are attributed as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Two identical independent flip rates; strictly positive harmonic confinement, repulsion and active speed; zero thermal diffusion; stationary two-particle gap only. Equivalence under general previously published transport equations remains a residual literature-priority issue; no global interior density formula is claimed.
title: Two distinct stationary gap-edge transitions in the two-particle active Dyson model
